affected_party: QIF adopters and accountable reviewers beginning empirical calibration
actual_problem: QIF can structure calibration reports but does not yet provide a prospective pilot contract that prevents planned, observing, missing, excluded, and completed outcome evidence from being conflated
why_it_matters: Without a prospective pilot boundary, example data or incomplete observations can be mistaken for empirical support and software-only evidence can overstate domain generality
why_now: v0.6.51 completes the pre-pilot evidence and recovery controls, while current evaluation practice emphasizes production monitoring, real outcomes, and human calibration
